title: Dyslexia, ADHD no barrier to Alegarbes' golden dreams
summary: Ariel Joseph Alegarbes, who has attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), dyslexia and asthma, tried athletics, boccia, and long jump before finding his place in swimming.
